format: new prototypical Jack in the Box restaurant built by the franchisee (excluding land)

invest.quote: The total investment necessary to begin operation of a Jack in the Box franchise you build is $1,909,500 to $4,041,500. This includes $95,000 to $127,500 that must be paid to Different Rules, LLC or its affiliates.

fee.quote: The Initial Franchise Fee is typically $50,000 for each franchised restaurant, plus any tax or other fee imposed upon the Company due to the collection of the Initial Franchise Fee.
fee.note: $2,500 per year if the term is shorter than the standard 20 years; $25,000 for nontraditional locations. Veterans Program: fee reduced by 25% ($12,500) to $37,500 for the first new Restaurant. Development Fee ($50,000 single unit; $50,000 + $10,000 per additional unit for new multi-unit developers; $10,000 per unit for existing franchisees) is credited toward the fee. Fees collected in the past fiscal year ranged from $0 to $50,000.

royalty.quote: Royalty (other than Royalty for Games & Devices) 5% of Gross Sales (see note 3) (unless eligible for a temporary reduction under our Select Market Incentive Program) Payable monthly on the 15th day of the next month

adFund.quote: Marketing fee 5% of Gross Sales Payable monthly on the 15th day of the next month ... Increases are capped at 0.5% of Gross Sales in any 24-month period.
adFund.note: 5% of Gross Sales; may increase by majority vote, capped at 0.5% per 24 months. Nontraditional typically 1%. No advertising cooperatives. $10,000 Grand Opening Advertising and Promotion Fee in Select Markets.

otherRecurring.name: Technology Fees
otherRecurring.amount: Monthly Technology Fee (currently $350-$500 per restaurant) plus Monthly Digital Fee (currently $0.00) plus Per Digital Transaction Fee (currently $0.00); anticipated to rise to $500-$675, $105 and $0.14-$0.30

otherRecurring.name: POS Software and support (paid to vendor)
Labor Management System fee
otherRecurring.amount: $72 fee plus $2.50 administrative fee per restaurant per month

otherRecurring.name: Stored Value Card Services Program Service Fee
Royalty for Games and Devices
otherRecurring.amount: 40% of net revenues from such games and devices

transferFee.amount: Sale or assignment fee: Up to $2,500 per restaurant

rentToFranchisor: Only if you lease a restaurant location from the Company or its affiliates (required when buying a company-operated restaurant; optional for new builds): monthly minimum rent (greater of underlying master-lease rent or 9.5% of 90% of trailing 52-week sales; for new openings currently 105% of underlying master lease rent) plus percentage rent, typically 9.5% of Gross Sales (after offsetting minimum rent), plus CAM, property taxes and assessments.

special: Royalty actually paid ranges from 0% to 12.5% as negotiated (nontraditional, new markets, incentives, settlements, franchised company sites). Select Market Incentive: royalty 2% for the first five years. Development Incentive Program: $150,000 0% loan per Restaurant repaid by crediting 100% of royalties. If the franchisee leases the site from the Company, percentage rent is typically 9.5% of Gross Sales. Franchisee must buy and have the Company install IT equipment ($45,000 to $60,000) and pays an 8% broker fee on technology procured through the Company.
